status_summary: An interim final rule published 2025-07-31 delayed the Super Emitter Program implementation deadline to 2027-01-22, and a final rule published and effective 2025-12-03 kept that date, citing unanticipated difficulties in implementing the novel program. On 2026-10-07 EPA announced that it would propose to rescind the Super Emitter Program, which lets third parties report large methane releases that operators must investigate, as the second part of its reconsideration of the 2024 oil and gas rules, with the proposal described as days away. No proposed rescission was found in the Federal Register as of 2026-10-13.

timeline.event: EPA published an interim final rule extending oil and gas methane rule deadlines, including delaying the Super Emitter Program implementation deadline to 2027-01-22.
EPA finalized the deadline extensions, keeping the Super Emitter Program start at 2027-01-22.
EPA announced that it would soon propose to rescind the Super Emitter Program.

title: Remove oil and gas rule provisions that let third parties trigger super-emitter responses
